messages:
rachel: heads-up — provisioning backlog in ap-south2. Several GPU attaches stuck with PROVISIONING_HELD. I traced high local nvme write latency on host cohort 'ap-south2-hotpool'.
omar: any SMART or kernel logs?
ops-bot: [ALERT] ap-south2-hotpool-####: nvme_write_95th=850ms -> 3.2s; media_errors +4 in 20m.
bryce: looking at our reclaimer traces: ephemeral-reclaimer kicked a deep clean across that cohort 15m ago with concurrency=20. That aligns with the attach wave.
rachel: yes — deep-clean starts at 1779999900, onboarding surge at 1779999945 -> attach failures spike.
omar: immediate action: reduce reclaimer concurrency and mark pool as provisioning-blocked. Also raise provisioner attach timeout temporarily.
bryce: patching now: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap ephemeral-reclaimer --type merge -p '{"data":{"default_workers":"4","overrides":"ap-south2-hotpool:2"}}'
kubectl label nodes -l pool=ap-south2-hotpool provisioning_blocked=true
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/provisioner ATTACH_TIMEOUT=60s
```
ops-bot: [INFO] reclaimer config patched by bryce at 1779999980. overrides applied. Nodes labeled provisioning_blocked=true.
rachel: quick smartctl short for one affected host: 
```
=== START OF SMART INFO ===
Device Model: ACME NVMe 4TB
SMART overall-health self-assessment test: FAILED
Media Errors: 7
Temperature: 62 C
```
omar: that looks nasty. Recommend isolating one drive for full long test; schedule replacement for hosts with failed SMART.
cost-ops: cross-region fallback option: shift 12% of critical provisioning to ap-northeast1 for 90m. Estimated extra cost ~$640 (reservations + egress). Want approval?
bryce: let's only shift urgent queues (training webhook, low-latency lanes). No bulk migrations.
oncall-sre: +1 — also enable auto-labeling rule so when nvme media_errors > 3 within 30m we set provisioning_blocked label automatically.
rachel: monitoring update 2m after throttling reclaimer: iostat snapshot: 
```
Device       r/s    w/s   await
nvme0n1      0.05  95.00  1.9
nvme1n1      0.01  12.00  0.7
```
rachel: attach success rate jumped from 84% to 96% over last 5m, queue draining.
bryce: opened follow-up ticket INFRA-4707 to track SMART history ingestion, host rebuilds, and add reclaimer time-window guardrail. Added initial replacement ETA in ticket.
cost-ops: approve partial fallback for urgent lanes; will route finances. Keep me posted if we need >2h.
omar: long-term action items in INFRA-4707: 1) cap reclaimer default concurrency to 6, 2) avoid deep-clean during peak provisioning windows (configurable blackout), 3) ship SMART ingestion to TSDB and alert on media_errors trend, 4) automated cohort labeling on nvme error spikes.
oncall-sre: applying temporary automation: added k8s cronjob that runs every 5m to check nvme errors and label nodes; will roll back after incident.
rachel: thanks team. I'll monitor and schedule replacements during next maintenance window for hosts with failing SMART. Dashboard pinned. 😅
